hypothesis_verdicts.statement: Y at position 39 combined with S at 54 drives high fitness, as seen in top variant YRGS.
Position 40 tolerates diverse residues; N, R, and G at 40 may each support high fitness in YxGS backgrounds.
The A-C-G motif at 39/41/54 (A39, C41, G54) is a strong alternative scaffold to YxGS.
Diverse low-predicted variants will reveal whether the model misses non-additive beneficial combinations.

required_output.hypotheses: 3 to 4 items of {statement, site, substitution, direction}; each statement at most 25 words
required_output.selection: exactly 96 variant ids taken from the shortlist, as a flat JSON array of strings and nothing else
required_output.reasons: mapping from variant id to a reason of at most 15 words, for 5 picks
required_output.output_limit: return these three keys only; no commentary, no per-variant annotations beyond the five reasons

structural_context: GB1 is a 56-residue IgG-Fc binding domain with a four-strand beta-sheet packed against one alpha-helix; positions 39, 40, 41 sit in the beta3-beta4 turn region and 54 on the last strand.
Positions 39/41 pack against the hydrophobic core side; 40 is the most solvent-exposed of the four and tolerates the widest range of substitutions.
biophysical_rules: Charged side chains change the local electrostatic environment in a context-dependent way; the sign of the effect is not fixed a priori.
Side-chain volume and hydrophobicity affect packing; a backbone-compatible substitution is not automatically a binding improvement.
Glycine and proline change backbone flexibility and are frequent sources of epistasis.
A substitution that is deleterious on its own can be beneficial in combination: do not discard a substitution only because its single-mutant value is low.
knowledge.zero_shot_note: structure_prior is a ProteinMPNN inverse-folding log-odds score (soluble v_48_002) on the 2GB1 backbone: log p(substitution | backbone) - log p(wild type | backbone). It reflects how compatible a residue is with the fold, which is NOT the same thing as binding to IgG-Fc; on this landscape it correlates only weakly with measured fitness.
